english.note: Use this for an insect-proof mesh screen fitted to a window, doorway, or sleeping area.

examples.english: The room has a mosquito screen, so we can keep the window open without worrying about mosquitoes coming in.
examples.traditional: 間房裝咗蚊網，開窗都唔怕蚊入嚟。
